name: paper-to-blog
description: Create source-faithful blog articles, conference posters, and single-image explainers from research papers supplied as local PDFs or arXiv URLs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn papers into blogs, posters, and explainer images.
interface.longDescription: Paper to Blog includes paper-to-blog for accessible HTML articles, paper-to-poster for conference research posters, and paper-to-image for single-image visual explainers. All accept local PDFs or arXiv links and preserve the paper’s evidence and limitations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF or arXiv paper into a clear, source-faithful blog version.
